question: John assembles computers and sells prebuilt computers as a business. The parts for the computer cost $800.  He sells the computers for 1.4 times the value of the components.  He manages to build 60 computers a month.  He has to pay $5000 a month in rent and another $3000 in non-rent extra expenses a month.  How much profit does he make a month?

steps.user_message: John assembles computers and sells prebuilt computers as a business. The parts for the computer cost $800.  He sells the computers for 1.4 times the value of the components. Parts cost: $800 per computer
Selling price: $800 × 1.4 = $1120 per computer
Computers per month: 60

Revenue: 60 × $1120 = $67,200
Cost of parts: 60 × $800 = $48,000
Rent: $5,000
Other expenses: $3,000

Total expenses: $48,000 + $5,000 + $3,000 = $56,000

Profit: $67,200 - $56,000 = $11,200

COT-END-S00-646BDB3E23D9
